name: tia_archive_project
description: Archive the open project to a compressed .zap21 file (Project.Archive). The project must be saved; existing archive files are never overwritten.

target_directory.description: Folder for the archive (created if missing).

mode.description: Archive mode (default: compressed). Only compressed archives can be retrieved.

save_first.description: Save unsaved changes before archiving (default: false = refuse).
